ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, approximately 80:20 across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central field. Dark grey to black banding localized along the distal trailing edges and proximal water line. Two discrete dark pixel clusters (focal spots) on the left lobe. One vertical yellowish-tan linear band observed near the central-right axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with a narrow base; internal vertex angle is approximately 30-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, with maximum peak-to-valley pixel distance observed at the outer lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broadly concave mathematical curve from the median notch extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, irregular dark pixel clusters consistent with biological growth localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single dark circular lesion or scar located in the interior region of the left lobe. Distinct vertical yellowish-tan discoloration streak extending from the central-right portion of the fluke surface toward the water line.
